newsitem.title: USA: Payless ShoeSource buys Parade of Shoes.
newsitem.headline: Payless ShoeSource buys Parade of Shoes.

text.p: Payless ShoeSource Inc said Tuesday it completed its previously announced acquisition of Parade of Shoes Inc from J. Baker Inc.
Payless said it acquired for net cash proceeds of about $28.0 million the Parade of Shoes inventory and trademarks, and assumed leases on 184 stores.
When the deal was first announced in January, terms were not disclosed.

Payless said Parade of Shoes posted sales of $123 million in 1996. It plans to operate Parade of Shoes as a separate division, supported by its existing sourcing, distribution, systems, real estate and financial organizations.
Parade of Shoes stores sell women's footwear and accessories in 14 states. Major markets include Boston, New York, Chicago, Philadelphia and Washington, D.C.

Payless said Bryan Collins will be senior vice president and division director for the newly acquired Parade of Shoes division. Collins has been senior vice president and general merchandise manager of women's shoes at Payless since 1994.
Payless is a family footwear retailer with 4,232 stores in 50 states, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands.
